test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

We forgot / to wish Susan / in her birthday / this year.
solution:
The correct answer is **in my birthday**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **On** should be used instead of** in**.
 
• **In** is used for **months, years, centuries and long periods**.
 
• The word “on” is used to refer to a calendar date, a day of the week, or a special day such as a birthday or anniversary.
 
 
• For example - on Christmas Day, on 6 March, etc
 
 
 
• Thus, the part that contains the error from the given options is contained in **option 3**.
